title: Telehealth POS-02 / Modifier-95 Adjudication
purpose: Govern adjudication of telehealth-delivered services billed with POS 02/10 and modifier 95/GT, consistent with the plan's telehealth benefit.
decision_rule: If the service is on the covered telehealth list, the telehealth benefit is active, and POS 02/10 with modifier 95/GT is present, approve at the allowed amount.
steps: Confirm place of service 02/10 and modifier 95/GT on the line
Verify the telehealth benefit is active for the member's plan (Eligibility DB)
Confirm the CPT is on the covered telehealth services list
Approve and pay at the allowed amount
references: Plan Benefit Policy TELE-001 — Telehealth Coverage
